method: Single-reviewer retrospective semantic assessment of the final model-visible sources. Not a blinded independent judge, not model answer quality. Full means enough visible evidence for all requested parts; partial means useful support for some part; none means no useful requested fact. Four unsupported-premise controls per panel are excluded from positive quality denominator. No missing facts are filled from source inspection or model memory.
